notes.title: Help us win a Community Favorite award!
notes.notes:
Hey guys. We are currently entered into an independent games contest over at http://www.indiepubgames.com/ . While the judges take time to figure out the grand prize winner, voting for the community favorite is underway now until the end of August.

The game with the most votes at the end of August will win $5,000! If you would like to help us out, all you have to do is register on the site and then go here: http://www.indiepubgames.com/vote.php and pick Turba! 

Everyone who registers is allowed one vote for the whole period, so if you can spare a few seconds sometime in the next month, please vote for us! And while you're logged in and voting, if you want to help boost our game rating feel free to rate it here: http://www.indiepubgames.com/game/Turba


Thanks to anyone out there who actually votes for us :)

notes.title: Version 1.6 out
notes.notes:
Version 1.6 of the game is out today, July 23rd. :)

Here is a list of changes in the new update:

        - Reworked the beat detection system.

        - Added top 10 most played artists and songs to the Scores menu.

        - Roulette, Auto Combo, and Zapper powers are unlocked faster. (25, 50, 75         activations down to 20, 40, 60 activations to unlock)

        - Fixed leader board scores not updating correctly sometimes when you got a         higher score.

        - Fixed bug in file browser that didn't allow CDs to be played.

        - Fixed bug in file browser that made folders not show up under certain drive letters.

        - Fixed Last.fm account name input to accept underscores.


The biggest change in this version is obviously the reworking of the beat detection system. Please feel free to give us feedback on the new system, and let us know how you feel it compares overall to the previous implementation!

notes.title: Turba Update Released
notes.notes:
The biggest change in this new update is the reworking of the game's beat detection system. After a lot of feedback, we overhauled the system in hopes of improving the experience for our players. We have also made it so that everyone's song count in the demo version will reset. We want everyone to be able to try out the new beat detection, and hope that if there are any people out there who were put off by the previous system, they will give the game another chance and possibly change their minds about buying the full version.


In addition to this, we have also fixed several bugs and added a couple of new features. Here is a list:

  • Added top 10 most played artists and songs to the Scores menu.

  • Roulette, Auto Combo and Zapper powers are unlocked faster. (25, 50, 75 activations down to
    20, 40, 60 activations to unlock)

  • Fixed leader board scores not updating correctly sometimes when you got a higher score.

  • Fixed bug in file browser that didn't allow CDs to be played.

  • Fixed bug in file browser that made folders not show up under certain drive letters.

  • Fixed Last.fm account name input to accept underscores."

notes.title: Turba Updated
notes.notes:
Turba has been updated.

Update features:
  • Folders can now be pinned to the root of the Computer section of the browser.
  • Added option to preview songs in the file browser.
  • Added options for menu music and sound volumes.
  • Added option for a left-handed mouse.
  • Game remembers what mode/power you last played with when going back to menu.
  • Old Colorblind blocks are now the default. Colorblind mode now has higher contrast colors.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! If you get an update for the game don't worry, it's nothing too major. We just wanted to get a bug fixed that was pointed out to us (one where you could use a bomb to grow your beat streak). We like to have a few new features in an update before it's an official "next version", but killing bugs as fast as possible is a big priority.

We did add support for Wavpack files though as well, since it was requested and took a couple minutes to do.

We've gotten some emails with suggestions that we are working on and hopefully we'll have a new version out sometime soon with some new stuff.

notes.title: Turba Released on Steam
notes.notes:
Turba provides a gameplay experience unlike any you have encountered before. Load in music from your PC and combo blocks to your favorite tunes in this unique new twist on the "match-3" style game!

The blocks on the game board generate and move to the beat of the song you choose. Clear blocks in time with the beat and make expert combos to maximize your score while you compete in online leaderboards for any and every song you play.

Buy Turba before July 13th and save 10%
